spec.description:
Foilboard Silver Joining Tape is a heavy-duty reinforced
aluminum foil tape engineered with a high-reflectance pure silver foil surface
to match the silver reflective face of Foilboard insulation panels. Backed with
an aggressive pressure-sensitive acrylic adhesive, it provides an airtight,
vapor-impermeable seal across panel joins, underfloor seams, and perimeter
junctions. It reflects radiant heat across the joint, preventing thermal bypass
and moisture vapor migration in wall, ceiling, and underfloor assemblies.
features:
Pure silver reflective foil finish matches the reflective face of
Foilboard panels

Reinforced fiberglass scrim provides high tensile strength
and tear resistance

High-tack pressure-sensitive acrylic adhesive ensures
permanent bonding

Class 1 vapor barrier rating prevents moisture transmission
across panel seams
Airtight seal eliminates drafts and convective heat loss

Low Flammability Index (≤ 5)
compliant with AS 1530.2

Available in 48mm and 72mm widths for versatile
on-site sealing

technical.value:
Reinforced aluminum foil with pure
silver reflective facing

spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable for bushfire construction
up to BAL-40 to AS 3959 when used with Foilboard systems
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability: Low VOC emissions; zero ozone-depleting potential (ODP)
install:
Ensure panel surfaces are dry, clean, and free of dust, grease,
and oil
Align Foilboard panels with edges tightly butted together

Center 72mm Silver Joining Tape over the joint on the silver reflective side of
the board

Peel paper release liner progressively while smoothing tape down
along the seam

Press down firmly along the entire tape length using a plastic
squeegee or roller to activate adhesive

Smooth out all wrinkles and air
pockets to achieve a permanent, airtight seal
selection_checklist: Confirm tape color matches the silver reflective face of Foilboard panels

Select width (72mm recommended for underfloor and wall seams; 48mm for narrow
trims)

Calculate total lineal meters of panel seams and perimeter
connections
limitations: Substrates must be dry and free of sawdust or grease before application

Requires firm mechanical pressure with a squeegee to achieve complete adhesive
activation
Not designed for structural mechanical holding
spec.warranty: Covered under Foilboard 25-year performance warranty system

use_cases:
Sealing
butt joints and seams on the silver face of Foilboard panels in suspended timber
underfloors

Taping seams on internal wall and ceiling Foilboard
installations

Creating an impermeable vapor seal around pipe and cable
penetrations through Foilboard panels
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard Silver Joining Tape
is a 72mm reinforced pure aluminum foil tape coated with an aggressive
cold-weather acrylic adhesive, designed to seal butt joints on the silver
reflective side of Foilboard panels. It forms an impermeable Class 1 vapor
barrier and airtight seal that prevents thermal bypass, convective drafts, and
moisture intrusion across wall, ceiling, and underfloor assemblies. Low
flammability rated (Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2), it ensures continuous radiant heat
reflection and compliance with NCC air-sealing standards.
